title: "task-management + agent-orchestration: ungoverned dispatch produces work the reviewer can never review"
epic: "EP-021"
acceptance: [{"text":"When a repository has a standing reviewer, tm dispatch and the pool treat governed admission as required unless config explicitly sets dispatch.governed to false; an unset value no longer skips admission. A dispatch without an admission record is refused with TM_GOVERNED_ADMISSION_REQUIRED naming 'ao-topology manage admit --task <id>'.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T18:01:20.733Z"},{"text":"When dispatch.governed is explicitly false, dispatch still succeeds but prints, and records on the task, that independent review through ao-topology reviewer will be unavailable for this task.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T18:01:20.886Z"},{"text":"The governed state is decided by one shared predicate used by tm dispatch, the pool and tm doctor (or equivalent), so the three cannot disagree; tm doctor reports repos where a reviewer exists but governed dispatch is explicitly off.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T18:01:21.062Z"},{"text":"An end-to-end test in a temporary repo with a registered reviewer: ungoverned dispatch is refused; manage admit then dispatch then finish report produces a revision that ao-topology reviewer request accepts.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T18:01:21.220Z"},{"text":"task-management and agent-orchestration CHANGELOGs and docs/agent-first.md describe the rule and name design-system TM-136 and marketplace TM-235 as the incidents.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T18:01:21.379Z"},{"text":"Plugin independence (Ryan, 2026-09-25): task-management and agent-orchestration each work with the other absent. No import or require crosses the boundary and no manifest dependency is declared; a call into the other plugin first capability-checks it (the tm binary as at agent-orchestration management.mjs:50, or the ao-topology binary as at task-management hostcaps.mjs) and skips silently when it is missing, without failing or blocking the rest of the operation. A test runs each side with the other plugin absent.","done":true,"at":"2026-09-25T18:01:21.530Z"}]

Reported 2026-09-25 by design-system lead d04c2baa (design-system TM-136, PR 121), and hit independently by this lead on TM-235 (PR 125) on 2026-09-24. task-management/lib/dispatch/index.mjs:121 runs governedAdmission only when config dispatch.governed === true or the task already has governance, so a repo with dispatch: {} dispatches straight to a worker and no admission record is written. agent-orchestration/topology/lib/reviewer.mjs:638 (trustedReviewRange) unconditionally requires management/<repoKey>/<task>.json with started, base_revision and finish.revision, and refuses with TOPOLOGY_REVIEWER_RANGE otherwise. manage admit cannot backfill, correctly: the task is already in_progress with no prior record (ownership-review-required). Result: finished, PR-ready work with no mechanical path to independent review; both affected tasks were reviewed out of band. Direction agreed with the reporter: admission-skipping is the defect, so fix it at dispatch (option a) rather than backfilling a base after the work exists (option b, weaker evidence). An operator must still be able to opt out explicitly.
